_comment: Our protocol id -> DeFiPunk’d slug (the key of `protocols` in its index.json). Child slugs only: a family slug (`aave`, `uniswap`, `spark`, `fluid`) carries the grades of whichever child DeFiPunk’d ranks best, so it never stands in for a version. Curve takes the DEX and the crvUSD CDP; `curve-llamalend` is left out until we decide whether LlamaLend belongs to our Curve row. Fluid and Spark take the one child DeFiPunk’d assesses (Fluid DEX, SparkLend); the note on each cell names it.
